verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצָּעֵק֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר צָפ֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ לְיִפְתָּ֜ח מַדּ֣וּעַ׀ עָבַ֣רְתָּ׀ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּבְנֵי־ עַמּ֗וֹן וְלָ֙נוּ֙ לֹ֤א קָרָ֙אתָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִמָּ֔ךְ בֵּיתְךָ֕ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘êq way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh way·yō·mə·rū lə·yip̄·tāḥ mad·dū·a‘ ‘ā·ḇar·tā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm biḇ·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·lā·nū lō qā·rā·ṯā lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘im·māḵ bê·ṯə·ḵā niś·rōp̄ ‘ā·le·ḵā bā·’êš
verses.literal: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed [the Jordan] to Zaphon They said to Jephthah Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites . . . - without calling us to go with you We will burn your house down . . . with you inside

verses.original: יִפְתָּח֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ וְעַמִּ֥י אֲנִ֛י הָיִ֛יתִי מְאֹ֑ד רִ֗יב וּבְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן וָאֶזְעַ֣ק אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ הוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·tāḥ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’îš wə·‘am·mî ’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî mə·’ōḏ rîḇ ū·ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wā·’ez·‘aq ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō- hō·wō·ša‘·tem ’ō·w·ṯî mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: But Jephthah replied - - My people and I had a serious conflict with the Ammonites . . . and when I called - you did not save me out of their hands

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְאֶ֞ה כִּֽי־ אֵינְךָ֣ מוֹשִׁ֗יע וָאָשִׂ֨ימָה בְכַפִּי֙ נַפְשִׁ֤י וָֽאֶעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיָדִ֑י וְלָמָ֞ה עֲלִיתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֛י הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·’eh kî- ’ê·nə·ḵā mō·šīʿ wā·’ā·śî·māh ḇə·ḵap·pî nap̄·šî wā·’e‘·bə·rāh ’el- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yā·ḏî wə·lā·māh ‘ă·lî·ṯem ’ê·lay hay·yō·wm haz·zeh lə·hil·lā·ḥem bî
verses.literal: When I saw that you would not save me I risked . . . my life and crossed over to the Ammonites . . . and the LORD delivered them into my hand Why then have you come . . . today . . . to fight against me

verses.original: יִפְתָּח֙ אֶת־ וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם אֶת־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַנְשֵׁ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶת־ וַיַּכּוּ֩ כִּ֤י אֶפְרַ֗יִם אָמְרוּ֙ אַתֶּ֔ם גִּלְעָ֕ד פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּת֥וֹךְ אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·tāḥ ’eṯ- way·yiq·bōṣ kāl- ’an·šê ḡil·‘āḏ way·yil·lā·ḥem ’eṯ- ’ep̄·rā·yim ’an·šê ḡil·‘āḏ ’eṯ- way·yak·kū kî ’ep̄·ra·yim ’ā·mə·rū ’at·tem gil·‘āḏ pə·lî·ṭê ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Jephthah then - gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim And the men of Gilead - struck them down because the Ephraimites had said You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim living in the territories of Ephraim . . . and Manasseh

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶֽת־ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד מַעְבְּר֥וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְֽ֠הָיָה כִּ֣י פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ יֹאמְר֞וּ אֶעֱבֹ֔רָה גִלְעָ֛ד וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ ל֧וֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ אַ֖תָּה הַֽאֶפְרָתִ֥י וַיֹּ֥אמֶֽר׀ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: gil·‘āḏ ’eṯ- way·yil·kōḏ ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ hay·yar·dên lə·’ep̄·rā·yim wə·hā·yāh kî pə·lî·ṭê ’ep̄·ra·yim yō·mə·rū ’e·‘ĕ·ḇō·rāh ḡil·‘āḏ way·yō·mə·rū lōw ’an·šê- ’at·tāh ha·’ep̄·rā·ṯî way·yō·mer lō
verses.literal: The Gileadites - captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim would say Let me cross over the Gileadites would ask him . . . Are you an Ephraimite If he answered No

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לוֹ֩ נָ֨א אֱמָר־ שִׁבֹּ֜לֶת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר סִבֹּ֗לֶת יָכִין֙ וְלֹ֤א לְדַבֵּ֣ר כֵּ֔ן וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אוֹת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁחָט֖וּהוּ אֶל־ מַעְבְּר֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הַהִיא֙ בָּעֵ֤ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם אָֽלֶף׃ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיִּפֹּ֞ל
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lōw nā ’ĕ·mār- šib·bō·leṯ way·yō·mer sib·bō·leṯ yā·ḵîn wə·lō lə·ḏab·bêr kên way·yō·ḥă·zū ’ō·w·ṯōw way·yiš·ḥā·ṭū·hū ’el- ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ hay·yar·dên ha·hî bā·‘êṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·na·yim ’ā·lep̄ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim way·yip·pōl
verses.literal: they told him Please say Shibboleth If he said Sibboleth because he could not pronounce it correctly they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan So at that time 42,000 {} . . . . . . Ephraimites were killed

verses.original: יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים יִפְתָּח֙ הַגִּלְעָדִ֔י וַיָּ֗מָת וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעָרֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: yip̄·tāḥ ’eṯ- way·yiš·pōṭ yiś·rā·’êl šêš šā·nîm yip̄·tāḥ hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî way·yā·māṯ way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·‘ā·rê ḡil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Jephthah - judged Israel six years and when he . . . died he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead

verses.original: אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־ אִבְצָ֖ן מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
verses.literal: After Jephthah - Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים בָּנוֹת֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח הַח֔וּצָה לְבָנָ֖יו הֵבִ֥יא וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנ֔וֹת מִן־ הַח֑וּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw šə·lō·šîm bā·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm bā·nō·wṯ šil·laḥ ha·ḥū·ṣāh lə·ḇā·nāw hê·ḇî ū·šə·lō·šîm bā·nō·wṯ min- ha·ḥūṣ way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: He had thirty sons as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere Ibzan judged - Israel seven years
Then Ibzan died and he was buried vvv in Bethlehem

verses.original: אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֵיל֖וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rāw ’ê·lō·wn haz·zə·ḇū·lō·nî way·yiš·pōṭ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: After Ibzan Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel - - - - ten years

verses.original: אֵל֣וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיָּ֖מָת וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּאַיָּל֖וֹן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lō·wn haz·zə·ḇū·lō·nî way·yā·māṯ way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·’ay·yā·lō·wn bə·’e·reṣ zə·ḇū·lun
verses.literal: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֖יו אֶת־ עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי׃ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
verses.literal: After Elon - Abdon son of Hillel from Pirathon judged Israel

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים רֹכְבִ֖ים עַל־ שִׁבְעִ֣ים עֲיָרִ֑ם וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw ’ar·bā·‘îm bā·nîm ū·šə·lō·šîm bə·nê ḇā·nîm rō·ḵə·ḇîm ‘al- šiḇ·‘îm ‘ă·yā·rim way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šə·mō·neh šā·nîm
verses.literal: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons . . . who rode on seventy donkeys And he judged - Israel eight years

verses.original: עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֑י וַיָּ֛מָת וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּהַ֖ר הָעֲמָלֵקִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḇ·dō·wn ben- hil·lêl hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·w·nî way·yā·māṯ way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·p̄ir·‘ā·ṯō·wn bə·’e·reṣ ’ep̄·ra·yim bə·har hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî
verses.literal: Then Abdon son of Hillel from Pirathon died and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim in the hill country of the Amalekites
